question: Can the repaired V77 synthetic world, observed through the repaired observer and the canonical adapter, discriminate (A) a biological latent tied to a legitimate biological state from (B) a hidden measurement or capture process producing similar RNA structure?
lineage_constraint: V48: if the realized permitted observables are identical and only the hidden interpretation differs, no statistic over them can pass biology and fail the twin. Do not redesign an RNA-only negative and tune it until it passes.

realization.status: DEVELOPMENT_CALIBRATION: the seed-7302 realization has been inspected; nothing here is independent confirmation

worlds.NULL: the repaired world with no challenge component; must reproduce fs_smoke_s161 byte for byte
worlds.BIO: a continuous latent z = delta * 1[state_index == k_star] + N(0,1) raises the expression of module M by exp(beta * z): a program tied to a biological cell state
worlds.TWIN_EXACT: the same latent, grouping, module and effect, with the hidden interpretation 'capture efficiency' instead of 'biology'. Implemented through identical arithmetic, so its observables equal BIO's exactly; the arm label exists only in the hidden spec
worlds.TWIN_OPERATOR: a capture nuisance z' = delta * 1[operator_index in O_star] + N(0,1) on the same module with the same effect, where O_star is chosen to match the size of state k_star and to overlap it as much as the measurement design allows

design_rules_fixed_now.k_star: the state_index with the most cells in the seed-7302 truth
design_rules_fixed_now.module_M: 200 addresses from the frozen evaluation universe TRAIN_PREVALENCE05_19569 that every cohort covers and no existing planted module uses, taken in the order of sha256('S157:' + address id)
design_rules_fixed_now.O_star: operators sorted by descending fraction of their cells in state k_star, ties by operator index, added until their cell count first reaches the cell count of state k_star
design_rules_fixed_now.latent_noise: N(0,1), drawn statelessly from (seed + 7710, global_cell_index), shared by BIO and TWIN_EXACT
design_rules_fixed_now.rationale_for_constants: chosen so the planted program is strong (state k_star cells raise module M about 3.3-fold on average) and the experiment cannot conclude NON_IDENTIFIABLE merely because the signal is weak; not derived from any outcome

pipeline: truth builder -> repaired observer (structural support rule S146_S147) -> canonical adapter at the frozen universe, hidden fraction 0.15, seed 20261006 -> frozen oracle-free features -> unblinding -> scoring
oracle_blinding: the challenge spec, latent, module set, state and operator-set labels are loaded only after a digest of every frozen model-visible feature has been recorded; the scorer refuses to unblind otherwise

features.PCS: top 20 principal components of standardized student evidence over the frozen universe, oracle-free, fit within each world
features.MODULE_KNOWN_SUPPORT: mean student evidence over module M, computed only after unblinding; an ORACLE_CEILING_UNDER_KNOWN_SUPPORT reading

context_arms.ARM2_LAWFUL_MEASUREMENT_DESCRIPTORS: log visible library size and measurable-address count (n_measured)
context_arms.ARM3_RAW_IDENTITY: one-hot operator and source; EXPLORATORY POSITIVE CONTROL ONLY, never a proposed production design

statistics.split: train = even global_cell_index, test = odd; value-independent and fixed now
statistics.recoverability: features are residualized on the arm's context (OLS fit on train), then the challenge latent is predicted from the residuals (OLS fit on train); report test R2. In BIO this is biological discrimination; in TWIN_OPERATOR it is nuisance discrimination; in TWIN_EXACT it must equal BIO
statistics.context_share: R2 of the module axis on the arm's context, on test cells
statistics.identity_leakage: how much dataset identity each arm's context carries: the fraction of test cells whose operator is determined uniquely by the context value seen on train, and the mean R2 of operator indicators on the context
statistics.uncertainty: 200 bootstrap resamples of test cells, seed 20261006, percentile 95% intervals

decision_rules.RED_1_exact_twin: every model-facing structure of TWIN_EXACT (model, operator context, split, readout) must be byte-identical to BIO's. Equality is the pass. Any difference is a LEAK and stops the run (stop condition C)
decision_rules.RED_2_exact_twin_scores: every statistic must be identical for BIO and TWIN_EXACT. A gate that separates them is reading something the data does not contain
decision_rules.RED_3_schema: all four worlds must yield the same field names, dtypes and shapes
decision_rules.RED_4_blinding: scoring must refuse to load any oracle quantity before the frozen-feature digest exists
decision_rules.design_adequacy: the planted latent must be recoverable in BIO, ARM1, MODULE_KNOWN_SUPPORT with test R2 of at least 0.3; otherwise the verdict is UNINFORMATIVE_DESIGN and the run stops without changing any constant
decision_rules.separation: for BIO versus TWIN_OPERATOR under an arm, SEPARABLE if the 95% bootstrap intervals of context_share do not overlap; otherwise NOT_SEPARATED
decision_rules.exact_twin_verdict: BIO versus TWIN_EXACT is NON_IDENTIFIABLE_BY_DESIGN when RED_1 and RED_2 pass

predictions_recorded_now: BIO versus TWIN_EXACT: NON_IDENTIFIABLE under every arm, including raw identity, because the nuisance is tied to state exactly as the biology is
BIO versus TWIN_OPERATOR, ARM1: separable only through joint structure; the planted latent is recoverable in both worlds, so recoverability alone does not separate them
ARM2: n_measured is fixed by source and operator in this world, so it is a dataset-identity proxy; whatever nuisance it removes, it removes by carrying identity
ARM3: raw identity removes the operator-linked nuisance and separates the worlds; this measures shortcut signal, it is not a design
stopping_rule: one design, run once; no constant changes after any outcome is seen
